context_requirements: Expression of TLR7 (or other TLRs) on the cell surface or in endosomes
For interferon and immunoproteasome genes, intact type I IFN signaling
For prostate lines, high TLR expression and PI3K-AKT/JAK-STAT coupling may enhance response
falsifiers: No induction of NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, RELB, NFKB2, or TICAM1 at 6 h in any line
No increase in interferon-stimulated genes (e.g., STAT1, PLSCR1, UBE2L6, HERC6) at 24 h
No change in antigen presentation genes (HLA-DRA, HLA-DMA, PSMB8, PSMB10, PSME1, PSME2) at 24 h
Strong and uniform up-regulation of proliferation genes at 24 h instead of the expected down-regulation
No difference in response between TLR7-high and TLR7-low lines

evidence.supports: TLR7 agonists induce a selected set of genes in human dendritic cells, often synergizing with other TLRs
TLR agonist combinations activate IL-12 and type I IFN pathways in T cells
TLR signaling in prostate cancer cells with high TLR expression flows through PI3K-AKT and JAK-STAT to OXPHOS and ROS
